review:
A straightforward 15-line Egyptian game where wilds triple any win they're part of – a nice boost in the base game.

After a win you can gamble on a card's colour (double) or suit (quadruple). Three scatters open free spins in the mummy's tomb, with retriggers. Low volatility, a 5,000x max and 96.96% RTP – one of the gentlest games here, much like Aztec Magic Deluxe.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
